surface_leak: A union bound over ranges gives a net of size (d/eps) log(1/eps).
why_negative: A matched pair inside one problem. The log is NOT removable in general (Komlos-Pach-Woeginger 1992) nor for halfspaces in R^4 (Pach-Tardos 2013); it IS removable for halfspaces in R^3 and for discs (Matousek-Seidel-Welzl). Any diagnostic that fires on the surface leak alone cannot separate these.
